answer: Starter identities may only vouch in cedar tier: cheap, but worth almost nothing. Promotion to copper requires tenure that cannot be bought or transferred, and ferrous weight is granted only when vouches cross independent clusters, capped by the min-cut between them. A clone farm therefore stalls at cedar, where each extra identity adds diminishing weight while the cross-cluster vouch it needs costs more than the last, so total spend grows faster than clone count and any correlated fault slashes them jointly.
